message.title: Saakshi alert: I may need help.
message.shareUntil: I'm sharing my location with you until {{time}}.
message.shareOpen: I'm sharing my location with you until I stop.
message.saving: Saakshi: my battery is at 5%. To save power, my location now updates every 5 minutes.

contacts.title: Trusted contacts
contacts.intro: These people get your alerts by text message. The list is kept only on this phone.
contacts.name: Name (optional)
contacts.phoneHint: A 10-digit mobile number, or one starting with +
contacts.invalid: That doesn't look like a phone number.
contacts.duplicate: That number is already on the list.
contacts.full: The list is full. Remove someone to add another.
contacts.usesIntro: Tick what each person gets. Everything is ticked for someone new.
contacts.usesNone: Nothing is ticked: this person gets no messages from Saakshi.

direct.heading: Send with no tap
direct.body: This version of Saakshi can text your contacts by itself, so an alert goes out even if you can't tap Send. Android asks you once to allow it.
direct.on: On: alerts go out by themselves after a 3-second countdown.
direct.denied: Not allowed. You can allow it in Android Settings, under Apps, Saakshi, Permissions.
direct.rationaleBody: Saakshi sends texts only when you send an alert, and only to your trusted contacts.

location.heading: Location
location.body: Allow location so your alerts include a map link to where you are.
location.denied: Location is off for Saakshi. Alerts will go without a map link until you allow it in the phone's Settings.

live.heading: Live location
live.body: Your trusted contacts get a link that shows where you are in any browser, until you stop. Your location goes to Saakshi's server only while sharing is on, and is deleted when it stops.
live.denied: Saakshi needs location permission to share where you are.
live.noticeBody: Your trusted contacts can see where you are until you stop.

bug.title: Pocket recording
bug.intro: Pocket recording records sound only, like a body-cam for sound, with the phone in your pocket or bag. It is for your own records, and carries on until you stop it or the battery runs out, with the screen locked too. The sound is saved as one file. About every 10 seconds, what has been recorded so far is fingerprinted and signed, so if the recording is cut off suddenly, it is still proven up to then.
bug.iosNote: While it records, iPhone shows a dot at the top of the screen and a Live Activity on the Lock Screen.
bug.androidNote: While it records, Android shows a notification.
bug.witnessOn: The latest fingerprint is texted to your trusted contacts, at most once every 10 minutes. Each fingerprint also vouches for everything recorded before it.
bug.witnessOff: On this phone the fingerprints are not texted by themselves. You can send a witness message from the Record tab.
bug.localNote: The recording stays on this phone, in the Record tab.
bug.noCheckpointYet: The first checkpoint is signed about 10 seconds after Start.
bug.failed_one: {{count}} file could not be signed; it is kept as it is.
bug.failed_other: {{count}} files could not be signed; they are kept as they are.
bug.micDenied: Saakshi needs microphone permission for Pocket recording.
bug.noticeText: Pocket recording is on. Open Saakshi to stop it.
bug.witness: Saakshi pocket recording: recording since {{from}}, signed up to {{to}}. SHA-256: {{hash}}

trigger.title: Quick trigger
trigger.intro: Open Saakshi's SOS screen in one step from outside the app: from the Lock Screen, a button or a widget. No code is typed. On the SOS screen, you swipe the action you want.
trigger.openHeading: How to open the SOS screen
trigger.iosControl: Control Center or Lock Screen: edit it, add a control, and choose Saakshi quick alert.
trigger.iosAction: Action Button (iPhone 15 Pro and later): Settings, Action Button, Controls, Saakshi quick alert.
trigger.iosWidget: Lock Screen widget: edit the Lock Screen and add Saakshi quick alert.
trigger.iosBackTap: Back Tap: in the Shortcuts app make a shortcut with Open Saakshi SOS, then choose it in Settings, Accessibility, Touch, Back Tap.
trigger.iosLocked: From a locked iPhone, iOS may ask for Face ID or your passcode before the SOS screen opens.
trigger.androidWidget: Home-screen widget: touch and hold the home screen, choose Widgets, and add Saakshi quick alert.
trigger.androidNotificationOn: The notification is on. Tapping it opens the SOS screen.
trigger.androidLocked: From a locked phone, Android asks you to unlock before the SOS screen opens.
trigger.notificationText: Tap to open the SOS screen.

call112Confirm.title: Call 112?
call112Confirm.body: Your phone will call 112, India's emergency number.

helpConfirm.title: Alert your trusted contacts?
helpConfirm.body: The people you ticked for SOS alerts get a text with the time and your location. Saakshi is not an emergency service: for the police, an ambulance or the fire service, call 112.

home.noLive: Nobody is ticked for live location. Choose who gets it in Settings, Trusted contacts.
home.noContacts: You have no trusted contacts for SOS alerts yet.

taken.label: My phone is being taken
taken.detail: Records sound, shares your location, alerts your contacts

confirm.title: Start "My phone is being taken"?
confirm.body: Saakshi records sound, shares your location until you stop it, and sends your SOS alert to your trusted contacts. It can only be stopped in Saakshi with your secret code.

needsCode.heading: A secret code is needed first
needsCode.body: "My phone is being taken" can only be stopped in Saakshi with your secret code, so it can't start until you have one. Set it now; then this starts.

taken.on: "My phone is being taken" is on
taken.liveOn: Your location is being shared until you stop it.
taken.alertSending: Your SOS alert is being sent…
taken.alertSent: Your SOS alert went to your trusted contacts.
taken.alertFailed: Your SOS alert couldn't be sent: {{detail}}
taken.stopNote: It can only be stopped in Saakshi with your secret code.

remind.title: Now lock your phone
remind.carriesOn: Sound recording and location sharing carry on with the screen locked.

lock.title: Lock the phone
lock.heading: Lock the phone when "My phone is being taken" starts
lock.what: When you swipe "My phone is being taken", Saakshi first starts recording sound, sharing your location and sending your alert. Then it locks the screen, as the power button does. You unlock it as usual.
lock.nothingElse: This permission lets Saakshi lock the screen and nothing else: it can't erase your phone or change your screen lock.
lock.deleting: While it is on, Android asks for it to be switched off before Saakshi can be deleted.
lock.offHere: You can switch it off here at any time, in one tap. It can also be switched off in your phone's settings.
lock.offInSaakshi: You can switch it off in Saakshi's Settings at any time, in one tap, or in your phone's settings.
lock.androidScreen: Next, Android shows its own screen to confirm. To switch this on, choose to activate it there.
lock.on: On. Saakshi locks the screen when "My phone is being taken" starts.
lock.off: Off. When "My phone is being taken" starts, Saakshi asks you to lock the phone yourself.
lock.failed: That didn't work. Please try again.
